question: private boolean isKeyInputValidSoFar() { Node currentNode = mValidKeysTree; for (int keyInputCode : mEnteredKeyInputs) { currentNode = currentNode.canReach(keyInputCode); if (currentNode == null) { return false; } } return true; }
answer: This function Traverse the tree to see if the keyInputs that have been entered so far are valid as is, or may become valid as more keyInputs are entered (excluding backspace).

question: private boolean isKeyedChronoCompletelyLawful() { if (mIs24HrViewFlag) { // For 24-hour mode, the time is legal if the hours and minutes are each legal. Note: // getInputChrono() will ONLY call isKeyedChronoCompletelyLawful() when NOT in 24hour mode. int[] chronoVals = getInputChrono(null); return (chronoVals[0] >= 0 && chronoVals[1] >= 0 && chronoVals[1] < 60); } else { // For AM/PM mode, the time is legal if it contains an AM or PM, as those can only be // legally added at specific times based on the tree's algorithm. return (mChronoKeys.contains(fetchAmOrPmCode(AM)) || mChronoKeys.contains(fetchAmOrPmCode(PM))); } }
answer: This function Check if the chrono that has been keyed so far is completely lawful, as is.

question: static HttpServer launchService() throws IOException { // create a new server listening at port 9091 HttpServer srvInstance = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(fetchBaseURI().getPort()), 0); // create a handler wrapping the JAX-RS application HttpHandler reqHandler = RuntimeDelegate.getInstance().createEndpoint(new JaxRsAppInstance(), HttpHandler.class); // map JAX-RS handler to the server root srvInstance.createContext(fetchBaseURI().getPath(), reqHandler); // start the server srvInstance.start(); return srvInstance; }
answer: This function Starts the lightweight HTTP service hosting the JAX-RS appInstance.

question: default <T> TaskContext<T> plan(final Operation<T> operation, final T performer) { if (isStopped()) { return Actions.emptyTaskContext(); // Case of post cancel scheduling } final SchedulableTaskContext<T> ctx = newContext(operation); ctx.setPerformer(performer); ctx.plan(); return unschedulableTaskContext(ctx); // Don't allow for mutation (it's running) }
answer: This function Schedules an operation referencing a performer for immediate execution.
